##### Modus ponens lietošana

[applyModusPonens.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/logicAndArgumentation/deductiveReasoning/skills/applyModusPonens.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Infer a consequent from a conditional and its antecedent without treating the inverse conditional as equivalent.

**User-friendly description (lv):** Lieto likumu: ja no A izriet B un A ir patiess, tad izriet B.

##### Modus tollens lietošana

[applyModusTollens.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/logicAndArgumentation/deductiveReasoning/skills/applyModusTollens.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Reject the antecedent of a conditional from the denial of its consequent, under the conditional as stated.

**User-friendly description (lv):** Izmanto nosacījumu un tā seku noliegumu, lai noliegtu priekšnosacījumu.

##### Deduktīva argumenta derīguma izvērtēšana

[assessDeductiveValidity.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/logicAndArgumentation/deductiveReasoning/skills/assessDeductiveValidity.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Determine whether a conclusion must hold if the premises hold, using logical structure rather than agreement with the conclusion.

**User-friendly description (lv):** Pārbaudi, vai visas premisas var būt patiesas, bet secinājums aplams.

##### Derīguma un pamatotības atšķiršana

[distinguishValidityFromSoundness.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/logicAndArgumentation/deductiveReasoning/skills/distinguishValidityFromSoundness.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize that a sound deductive argument requires both a valid inference and true premises.

**User-friendly description (lv):** Saproti, kāpēc loģiski derīgam argumentam tomēr var būt aplamas premisas.

##### Kategoriska siloģisma izvērtēšana

[evaluateACategoricalSyllogism.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/logicAndArgumentation/deductiveReasoning/skills/evaluateACategoricalSyllogism.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Examine whether relations among classes support the proposed conclusion, rather than relying on familiar subject matter.

**User-friendly description (lv):** Nosaki, vai apgalvojumi par kategorijām loģiski pamato secinājumu.

##### Pretrunas apgalvojumu kopā atpazīšana

[identifyAContradictionInASetOfClaims.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/logicAndArgumentation/deductiveReasoning/skills/identifyAContradictionInASetOfClaims.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Show where commitments cannot all be true together under the same meanings and conditions.

**User-friendly description (lv):** Atpazīsti apgalvojumus, kas vienādos apstākļos nevar visi būt patiesi.

#### Nededuktīvā spriešana

Skills: 4

[nonDeductiveReasoning.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/logicAndArgumentation/nonDeductiveReasoning/nonDeductiveReasoning.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Many reasonable arguments support conclusions without guaranteeing them. Their strength depends on evidence, alternatives, sampling, or explanatory power rather than formal certainty.

**User-friendly description (lv):** Mācies vērtēt spriešanu, kas pamato secinājumu, taču negarantē noteiktību.

##### Deduktīvas noteiktības un varbūtiska atbalsta atšķiršana

[distinguishDeductiveCertaintyFromProbabilisticSupport.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/logicAndArgumentation/nonDeductiveReasoning/skills/distinguishDeductiveCertaintyFromProbabilisticSupport.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize that a well-supported conclusion can remain revisable when the reasoning is non-deductive.

**User-friendly description (lv):** Atšķir loģiski drošus secinājumus no secinājumiem, ko pamato varbūtība.

##### Induktīva vispārinājuma izvērtēšana

[evaluateAnInductiveGeneralization.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/logicAndArgumentation/nonDeductiveReasoning/skills/evaluateAnInductiveGeneralization.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Judge how well observed cases support a claim about a broader population, including the relevance of selection and variation.

**User-friendly description (lv):** Izvērtē, cik labi novērotie piemēri pamato plašāku vispārinājumu.

##### Secinājuma par labāko skaidrojumu izvērtēšana

[evaluateAnInferenceToTheBestExplanation.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/logicAndArgumentation/nonDeductiveReasoning/skills/evaluateAnInferenceToTheBestExplanation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Compare hypotheses by how well they explain evidence, their assumptions, and their fit with alternative explanations.

**User-friendly description (lv):** Izvēlies starp iespējamiem skaidrojumiem pēc pierādījumiem un pieņēmumiem.

##### Analoģiskās spriešanas izvērtēšana

[evaluateAnalogicalReasoning.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/logicAndArgumentation/nonDeductiveReasoning/skills/evaluateAnalogicalReasoning.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Check whether compared cases share features relevant to the proposed conclusion rather than merely superficial similarities.

**User-friendly description (lv):** Salīdzini gadījumus pēc līdzībām, kas patiešām svarīgas secinājumam.

#### Predikātu loģika

Skills: 6

[predicateLogic.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/logicAndArgumentation/predicateLogic/predicateLogic.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Variables and quantifiers permit reasoning about individuals and collections. The relevant universe and scope of each quantifier must be made explicit to evaluate meaning and inference.

**User-friendly description (lv):** Izpēti, kā kvantori izsaka apgalvojumus par visiem vai dažiem kopas elementiem.

##### Kvantora darbības jomas analīze

[analyzeTheScopeOfAQuantifier.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/logicAndArgumentation/predicateLogic/skills/analyzeTheScopeOfAQuantifier.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify which variables and expressions are governed by a quantifier and how scope changes the meaning of a formula.

**User-friendly description (lv):** Atpazīsti, kā kvantora vieta maina izteikuma nozīmi.

##### Predikātu un izteikumu atšķiršana

[distinguishPredicatesFromPropositions.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/logicAndArgumentation/predicateLogic/skills/distinguishPredicatesFromPropositions.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize a predicate with an unbound variable as an open expression and a proposition as a statement with specified truth conditions.

**User-friendly description (lv):** Atšķir atvērtu izteiksmi ar mainīgo no pilnīga izteikuma.

##### Secinājuma ar kvantoriem izvērtēšana

[evaluateAnInferenceWithQuantifiers.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/logicAndArgumentation/predicateLogic/skills/evaluateAnInferenceWithQuantifiers.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Check whether a conclusion about all or some members of a domain follows from quantified premises under a stated interpretation.

**User-friendly description (lv):** Pārbaudi, vai premisas ar kvantoriem tiešām nozīmē piedāvāto secinājumu.

##### Eksistenciālās kvantifikācijas interpretēšana

[interpretExistentialQuantification.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/logicAndArgumentation/predicateLogic/skills/interpretExistentialQuantification.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Determine what it means for at least one element of a specified domain to satisfy a property, without implying uniqueness.

**User-friendly description (lv):** Saproti, ka „eksistē“ nozīmē vismaz vienu nosacījumam atbilstošu piemēru.

##### Universālās kvantifikācijas interpretēšana

[interpretUniversalQuantification.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/logicAndArgumentation/predicateLogic/skills/interpretUniversalQuantification.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Determine what it means for a property to hold for every element of a specified domain and how one counterexample would matter.

**User-friendly description (lv):** Izproti izteikumu, kas attiecas uz katru noteiktas kopas elementu.

##### Kvantificēta izteikuma noliegšana

[negateAQuantifiedProposition.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/logicAndArgumentation/predicateLogic/skills/negateAQuantifiedProposition.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Use the relationships between not-all and some-not, and between none and there-exists, to interpret negation accurately.

**User-friendly description (lv):** Noliedz izteikumus ar „visi“ vai „daži“, nekļūdaini saglabājot nozīmi.

#### Izteikumu loģika

Skills: 9

[propositionalLogic.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/logicAndArgumentation/propositionalLogic/propositionalLogic.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Truth-functional connections between propositions determine the logical properties of compound statements. Symbolic operators and truth tables clarify implications independent of the subject matter used in examples.

**User-friendly description (lv):** Uzzini, kā darbojas ar loģiskiem operatoriem savienotu izteikumu patiesuma nosacījumi.

##### Izteikuma klasifikācija ar patiesumtabulu

[classifyAPropositionUsingATruthTable.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/logicAndArgumentation/propositionalLogic/skills/classifyAPropositionUsingATruthTable.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish tautological, contradictory, and contingent expressions through their truth values under all assignments.

**User-friendly description (lv):** Ar patiesumtabulām atpazīsti vienmēr patiesus, vienmēr aplamus un kontingentus izteikumus.

##### Patiesumtabulas izveide

[constructATruthTable.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/logicAndArgumentation/propositionalLogic/skills/constructATruthTable.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Enumerate truth-value combinations for atomic propositions and systematically compute outcomes of logical expressions.

**User-friendly description (lv):** Izveido tabulu ar iespējamām loģiskās izteiksmes patiesuma vērtībām.

##### Atomāru un saliktu izteikumu atšķiršana

[distinguishAtomicFromCompoundPropositions.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/logicAndArgumentation/propositionalLogic/skills/distinguishAtomicFromCompoundPropositions.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** A proposition can stand alone or form part of a statement built with logical connectives; truth-functional structure differs from the number of words in an ordinary sentence.

**User-friendly description (lv):** Atšķir atsevišķu izteikumu no izteikuma, kas veidots ar loģiskām saiknēm.

##### Loģiskās ekvivalences interpretēšana

[interpretLogicalBiconditional.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/logicAndArgumentation/propositionalLogic/skills/interpretLogicalBiconditional.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Assess 'if and only if' statements as two-way conditional relationships, rather than treating either one-way conditional as sufficient.

**User-friendly description (lv):** Saproti, ka „tad un tikai tad, ja“ prasa implikāciju abos virzienos.

##### Loģiskās konjunkcijas interpretēšana

[interpretLogicalConjunction.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/logicAndArgumentation/propositionalLogic/skills/interpretLogicalConjunction.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Apply the truth conditions of logical 'and' while distinguishing conjunction from a chronological or causal relationship.

**User-friendly description (lv):** Atpazīsti, kad loģisks izteikums ar „UN“ ir patiess.

##### Loģiskās disjunkcijas interpretēšana

[interpretLogicalDisjunction.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/logicAndArgumentation/propositionalLogic/skills/interpretLogicalDisjunction.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Apply the truth conditions of inclusive 'or' and distinguish these from interpretations that require exactly one alternative.

**User-friendly description (lv):** Izproti iekļaujošo „VAI“, kur abas iespējas var būt patiesas.

##### Loģiskā nolieguma interpretēšana

[interpretLogicalNegation.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/logicAndArgumentation/propositionalLogic/skills/interpretLogicalNegation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Determine when the denial of a proposition is true and distinguish negation from a stronger contrary statement.

**User-friendly description (lv):** Saproti, kā apgalvojuma noliegums maina tā patiesuma nosacījumus.

##### Materiālās implikācijas interpretēšana

[interpretMaterialImplication.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/logicAndArgumentation/propositionalLogic/skills/interpretMaterialImplication.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Determine when a conditional is true in classical propositional logic without confusing logical implication with causation.

**User-friendly description (lv):** Saproti, kad nosacījuma izteikums ir patiess klasiskajā izteikumu loģikā.

##### Deduktīvā derīguma pārbaude ar patiesumtabulu

[testDeductiveValidityUsingATruthTable.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/logicAndArgumentation/propositionalLogic/skills/testDeductiveValidityUsingATruthTable.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Search for a case in which all premises are true but the conclusion false to determine propositional validity.

**User-friendly description (lv):** Pārbaudi dedukciju, meklējot gadījumu ar patiesām premisām un aplamu secinājumu.

### Metafizika

Groups: 4 · Skills: 14

[metaphysics.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/metaphysics/metaphysics.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Metaphysics examines the most general categories of reality, such as what exists, how things persist, and what makes events possible. Its conceptual questions differ from describing particular natural mechanisms in the sciences.

**User-friendly description (lv):** Izpēti filozofiskus jautājumus par esamību, identitāti, realitāti, laiku un iespējamību.

#### Cēloņsakarība, laiks un iespējamība

Skills: 4

[causationTimeAndPossibility.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/metaphysics/causationTimeAndPossibility/causationTimeAndPossibility.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Metaphysical inquiry asks what causal dependence means and how temporal or modal claims relate beyond specific measurements.

**User-friendly description (lv):** Izpēti filozofiskas idejas par cēloņiem, laiku un to, kas varēja notikt.

##### Salīdzināt filozofiskus laika skaidrojumus

[comparePhilosophicalAccountsOfTime.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/metaphysics/causationTimeAndPossibility/skills/comparePhilosophicalAccountsOfTime.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain differences between views that privilege the present and views treating past, present, and future as equally real.

**User-friendly description (lv):** Salīdzini uzskatu, ka reāla ir tikai tagadne, ar uzskatu, ka visi laiki ir vienlīdz reāli.

##### Atšķirt cēloņsakarību no notikumu secības

[distinguishCausationFromTemporalSuccession.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/metaphysics/causationTimeAndPossibility/skills/distinguishCausationFromTemporalSuccession.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize that one event occurring before another does not itself establish a productive or counterfactual dependence.

**User-friendly description (lv):** Agrāks notikums ne vienmēr izraisa vēlāku.

##### Atšķirt iespējamību no nepieciešamības

[distinguishPossibilityFromNecessity.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/metaphysics/causationTimeAndPossibility/skills/distinguishPossibilityFromNecessity.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify claims that could be otherwise and those held to be true in every relevant possible circumstance.

**User-friendly description (lv):** Atšķir to, kas varētu notikt, no tā, kam obligāti jābūt patiesam.

##### Izvērtēt kontrfaktisku apgalvojumu

[evaluateACounterfactualClaim.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/metaphysics/causationTimeAndPossibility/skills/evaluateACounterfactualClaim.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Examine what would follow if specified conditions had differed while keeping relevant background assumptions coherent.

**User-friendly description (lv):** Apsver, kas varētu notikt iedomātos citādos apstākļos.

#### Esamība un kategorijas

Skills: 3

[existenceAndCategories.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/metaphysics/existenceAndCategories/existenceAndCategories.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Different theories posit concrete objects, properties, events, or abstract entities; their classification determines what kinds of ontological commitments a claim makes.

**User-friendly description (lv):** Izpēti dažāda veida lietas, ko filozofi uzskata par reālām.

##### Atšķirt konkrētas un abstraktas entītijas

[distinguishConcreteFromAbstractEntities.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/metaphysics/existenceAndCategories/skills/distinguishConcreteFromAbstractEntities.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Assess whether a proposed entity has spatial or causal features characteristic of concrete things or is treated as abstract, such as a mathematical object.

**User-friendly description (lv):** Atšķir fiziskus priekšmetus no tādām abstraktām entītijām kā skaitļi vai idejas.

##### Atšķirt īpašības no objektiem

[distinguishPropertiesFromObjects.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/metaphysics/existenceAndCategories/skills/distinguishPropertiesFromObjects.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Separate a bearer from qualities attributed to it, while recognizing that some metaphysical theories analyze this distinction differently.

**User-friendly description (lv):** Atšķir pašu objektu no īpašībām, kas tam piedēvētas.

##### Izvērtēt apgalvojumu par esamību

[evaluateAnExistenceClaim.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/metaphysics/existenceAndCategories/skills/evaluateAnExistenceClaim.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Examine the criteria by which something is said to exist rather than assuming that naming it settles its ontological status.

**User-friendly description (lv):** Pajautā, kādi pierādījumi vai spriedumi pamato, ka kaut kas pastāv.

#### Identitāte un pastāvēšana laikā

Skills: 4

[identityAndPersistence.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/metaphysics/identityAndPersistence/identityAndPersistence.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Questions about sameness arise when material, properties, or relations change over time. Numerical identity is different from merely sharing characteristics.

**User-friendly description (lv):** Jautā, kāpēc lieta paliek tā pati arī pārmaiņu gaitā.

##### Analizēt metafizisku paradoksu

[analyzeAMetaphysicalParadox.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/metaphysics/identityAndPersistence/skills/analyzeAMetaphysicalParadox.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify apparently plausible assumptions that generate inconsistent conclusions in a puzzle about reality.

**User-friendly description (lv):** Atklāj pretrunīgus pieņēmumus mīklās par realitātes dabu.

##### Analizēt daļas un veseluma attiecības

[analyzeAPartWholeRelation.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/metaphysics/identityAndPersistence/skills/analyzeAPartWholeRelation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Examine whether a component and a composite have different identities and what changes follow from replacing parts.

**User-friendly description (lv):** Izpēti, kā priekšmeta daļas saistītas ar veselumu, ko tās veido.

##### Atšķirt skaitlisko un kvalitatīvo identitāti

[distinguishNumericalFromQualitativeIdentity.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/metaphysics/identityAndPersistence/skills/distinguishNumericalFromQualitativeIdentity.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify the difference between being one and the same entity and being indistinguishable in specified properties.

**User-friendly description (lv):** Atšķir vienu un to pašu objektu no lietām, kas tikai izskatās vienādas.

##### Izvērtēt saglabāšanos pārmaiņu gaitā

[evaluatePersistenceThroughChange.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/metaphysics/identityAndPersistence/skills/evaluatePersistenceThroughChange.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Assess competing criteria for when an object remains the same despite replacement, growth, or alteration.

**User-friendly description (lv):** Apsver, vai detaļu nomaiņa maina priekšmeta identitāti.

#### Matemātiskā realitāte

Skills: 3

[mathematicalReality.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/metaphysics/mathematicalReality/mathematicalReality.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Philosophical accounts of mathematics disagree over whether its objects exist independently, are constructs of formal language, or are positions within structures. These ontological commitments are distinct from learning to perform mathematical operations.

**User-friendly description (lv):** Izpēti strīdu par to, vai matemātiskie objekti pastāv neatkarīgi no cilvēkiem.

##### Analizēt matemātisko strukturālismu

[analyzeMathematicalStructuralism.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/metaphysics/mathematicalReality/skills/analyzeMathematicalStructuralism.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Evaluate the claim that mathematical objects are understood through positions and relations in structures rather than through individually identifying intrinsic properties.

**User-friendly description (lv):** Izpēti, vai matemātiskus objektus vislabāk izprast pēc to savstarpējām attiecībām.

##### Izvērtēt matemātisko nominālismu

[evaluateMathematicalNominalism.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/metaphysics/mathematicalReality/skills/evaluateMathematicalNominalism.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Examine strategies for understanding mathematical language and successful reasoning without committing to independently existing abstract mathematical objects.

**User-friendly description (lv):** Apsver, kā matemātiska spriešana var darboties bez neatkarīgi pastāvošiem abstraktiem objektiem.

##### Izvērtēt matemātisko platonismu

[evaluateMathematicalPlatonism.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/metaphysics/mathematicalReality/skills/evaluateMathematicalPlatonism.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Assess the view that mathematical objects or structures exist independently of human thought and how it attempts to explain the apparent objectivity of mathematics.

**User-friendly description (lv):** Izpēti argumentus, ka matemātiskas entītijas pastāv neatkarīgi no cilvēka prāta.

### Prāts, patība un cilvēka eksistence

Groups: 4 · Skills: 17

[mindSelfAndHumanExistence.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/mindSelfAndHumanExistence/mindSelfAndHumanExistence.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Questions about subjective experience, the continuity of the self, deliberate action, and a meaningful human life cannot be resolved solely through psychological measurement. This domain examines theories of mind, identity, agency, and existential commitments, distinguishing them from empirical mental-health claims.

**User-friendly description (lv):** Izpēti filozofiskus jautājumus par apziņu, personisko identitāti, brīvību un dzīves jēgu.

#### Rīcībspēja un brīvā griba

Skills: 5

[agencyAndFreeWill.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/mindSelfAndHumanExistence/agencyAndFreeWill/agencyAndFreeWill.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Acting for reasons, selecting among alternatives, and being accountable are connected but separable philosophical ideas.

**User-friendly description (lv):** Izpēti, kā izvēle, rīcības iemesli un atbildība saistās ar brīvību.

##### Salīdzināt brīvību kompatibilisma un inkompatibilisma skatījumā

[compareCompatibilistAndIncompatibilistFreedom.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/mindSelfAndHumanExistence/agencyAndFreeWill/skills/compareCompatibilistAndIncompatibilistFreedom.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Examine whether meaningful free action is possible under determinism and how rival views define freedom.

**User-friendly description (lv):** Izpēti, vai brīvība un atbildība var pastāvēt līdzās determinismam.

##### Salīdzināt determinismu un indeterminismu

[compareDeterminismAndIndeterminism.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/mindSelfAndHumanExistence/agencyAndFreeWill/skills/compareDeterminismAndIndeterminism.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain the different claims about how events are determined and why randomness alone does not establish control.

**User-friendly description (lv):** Salīdzini pilnīgi noteiktu pasauli ar tādu, kur iespējami nenoteikti notikumi.

##### Atšķirt rīcību no notikuma

[distinguishAnActionFromAnEvent.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/mindSelfAndHumanExistence/agencyAndFreeWill/skills/distinguishAnActionFromAnEvent.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify whether a description invokes an agent's intention or reason rather than only something that happened to a body.

**User-friendly description (lv):** Atšķir apzinātu rīcību no tā, kas vienkārši notiek.

##### Atšķirt rīcības pamatojumus no uzvedības cēloņiem

[distinguishReasonsForActionFromCausesOfBehavior.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/mindSelfAndHumanExistence/agencyAndFreeWill/skills/distinguishReasonsForActionFromCausesOfBehavior.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Separate justifying considerations from causal explanations, recognizing that the two may be related.

**User-friendly description (lv):** Atšķir iemeslus, kas pamato rīcību, no cēloņiem, kas izskaidro uzvedību.

##### Novērtēt morālās atbildības nosacījumus

[evaluateConditionsOfMoralResponsibility.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/mindSelfAndHumanExistence/agencyAndFreeWill/skills/evaluateConditionsOfMoralResponsibility.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Consider knowledge, control, intention, and coercion in judging whether blame or praise is warranted.

**User-friendly description (lv):** Apsver, kādas zināšanas un kontrole vajadzīgas morālai atbildībai.

#### Cilvēka eksistence un jēga

Skills: 4

[humanExistenceAndMeaning.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/mindSelfAndHumanExistence/humanExistenceAndMeaning/humanExistenceAndMeaning.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Existential reflection examines how people understand purpose, authenticity, finitude, and commitments, without prescribing a single life ideal or substituting for mental-health care.

**User-friendly description (lv):** Izpēti filozofiskas pieejas jēgpilnai un autentiskai dzīvei.

##### Analizēt autentiskumu kā filozofisku jēdzienu

[analyzeAuthenticityAsAPhilosophicalConcept.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/mindSelfAndHumanExistence/humanExistenceAndMeaning/skills/analyzeAuthenticityAsAPhilosophicalConcept.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Evaluate competing claims about acting from one's commitments, social expectations, and self-understanding.

**User-friendly description (lv):** Izpēti, vai autentiska rīcība prasa neatkarību no sabiedrības gaidām.

##### Analizēt mirstīguma filozofisko nozīmi

[analyzeThePhilosophicalSignificanceOfMortality.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/mindSelfAndHumanExistence/humanExistenceAndMeaning/skills/analyzeThePhilosophicalSignificanceOfMortality.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Examine how finitude affects arguments about priorities and meaning rather than making predictions about an individual's emotional response.

**User-friendly description (lv):** Pārdomā, kā cilvēka mirstīgums var veidot argumentus par dzīves prioritātēm.

##### Salīdzināt filozofiskus uzskatus par dzīves jēgu

[comparePhilosophicalAccountsOfMeaningInLife.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/mindSelfAndHumanExistence/humanExistenceAndMeaning/skills/comparePhilosophicalAccountsOfMeaningInLife.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Contrast accounts that ground human meaning in relationships, achievement, self-authorship, transcendence, religious commitments, or nonreligious purposes, assessing their philosophical reasons without requiring adherence to any worldview.

**User-friendly description (lv):** Salīdzini dažādas idejas par to, kas piešķir jēgu cilvēka dzīvei.

##### Atšķirt dzīves mērķi no īslaicīgas vēlmes

[distinguishALifePurposeFromAPassingPreference.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/mindSelfAndHumanExistence/humanExistenceAndMeaning/skills/distinguishALifePurposeFromAPassingPreference.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Examine how sustained commitments and values differ from momentary wants when evaluating an account of a meaningful life.

**User-friendly description (lv):** Atšķir ilgtermiņa dzīves apņemšanās no mirkļa vēlmēm.

#### Prāts un apziņa

Skills: 4

[mindAndConsciousness.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/mindSelfAndHumanExistence/mindAndConsciousness/mindAndConsciousness.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** A first-person experience and a third-person physical description offer different perspectives on mental life. Philosophical theories disagree about how these perspectives relate.

**User-friendly description (lv):** Atklāj dažādus veidus, kā izprast subjektīvo pieredzi un prātu.

##### Analizēt mākslīgās apziņas filozofisku problēmu

[analyzeAPhilosophicalProblemOfArtificialConsciousness.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/mindSelfAndHumanExistence/mindAndConsciousness/skills/analyzeAPhilosophicalProblemOfArtificialConsciousness.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Assess what would and would not count as evidence of experience in an artificial system, without claiming a settled test exists.

**User-friendly description (lv):** Apsver, kādi pierādījumi varētu pamatot apgalvojumu par mākslīgo apziņu.

##### Salīdzināt prāta un ķermeņa attiecību teorijas

[compareTheoriesOfTheMindBodyRelation.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/mindSelfAndHumanExistence/mindAndConsciousness/skills/compareTheoriesOfTheMindBodyRelation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Contrast representative views such as physicalism and dualism by their commitments and explanatory challenges.

**User-friendly description (lv):** Salīdzini filozofiskos skaidrojumus par prāta un ķermeņa saistību.

##### Atšķirt mentālus un fiziskus aprakstus

[distinguishMentalFromPhysicalDescriptions.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/mindSelfAndHumanExistence/mindAndConsciousness/skills/distinguishMentalFromPhysicalDescriptions.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify when a claim describes subjective experience, observable behavior, or bodily processes, and why they are not automatically equivalent.

**User-friendly description (lv):** Atšķir jūtu aprakstus no fizisko procesu aprakstiem smadzenēs.

##### Izskaidrot citu prātu problēmu

[explainTheProblemOfOtherMinds.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/mindSelfAndHumanExistence/mindAndConsciousness/skills/explainTheProblemOfOtherMinds.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Describe why another being's subjective experiences are not observed in the same way as one's own, and what kinds of inferences are used.

**User-friendly description (lv):** Jautā, kā mēs varam zināt, vai citai būtnei ir subjektīva pieredze.

#### Personiskā identitāte

Skills: 4

[personalIdentity.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/mindSelfAndHumanExistence/personalIdentity/personalIdentity.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** The self may be characterized by bodily, psychological, narrative, or relational continuity. The question is what makes someone the same person, not how memory works empirically.

**User-friendly description (lv):** Izpēti, kāpēc cilvēks paliek tā pati persona, lai gan laika gaitā mainās.

##### Analizēt personas statusa kritēriju

[analyzeAPersonhoodCriterion.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/mindSelfAndHumanExistence/personalIdentity/skills/analyzeAPersonhoodCriterion.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Test a proposed condition of being a person against borderline cases without assigning anyone lesser real-world dignity.

**User-friendly description (lv):** Pārbaudi personas statusa kritērijus sarežģītos gadījumos, nenoliedzot cilvēka cieņu.

##### Salīdzināt ķermeniskās un psiholoģiskās nepārtrauktības teorijas

[compareBodilyAndPsychologicalContinuityAccounts.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/mindSelfAndHumanExistence/personalIdentity/skills/compareBodilyAndPsychologicalContinuityAccounts.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Assess how different criteria handle change, memory loss, and hypothetical transfer scenarios.

**User-friendly description (lv):** Salīdzini uz ķermeni un psiholoģiju balstītus personiskās identitātes skaidrojumus.

##### Atšķirt personisko identitāti no līdzības

[distinguishPersonalIdentityFromSimilarity.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/mindSelfAndHumanExistence/personalIdentity/skills/distinguishPersonalIdentityFromSimilarity.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain why sharing a personality or appearance is not enough to establish that two persons are numerically identical.

**User-friendly description (lv):** Saproti, kāpēc divi līdzīgi cilvēki nav obligāti viena un tā pati persona.

##### Novērtēt atmiņas lomu personiskajā identitātē

[evaluateTheRoleOfMemoryInPersonalIdentity.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/mindSelfAndHumanExistence/personalIdentity/skills/evaluateTheRoleOfMemoryInPersonalIdentity.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Examine the philosophical significance and limitations of remembered experience as a criterion of persistence.

**User-friendly description (lv):** Izpēti, vai atmiņas pietiek, lai pamatotu personisko nepārtrauktību.

### Filozofiskā izpēte

Groups: 3 · Skills: 12

[philosophicalInquiry.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophicalInquiry/philosophicalInquiry.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Philosophy investigates conceptual, normative, and foundational questions whose answers require reasons rather than observation alone. This domain concerns the practices used to formulate, refine, and discuss such questions; it is distinct from the formal evaluation of arguments in Logic.

**User-friendly description (lv):** Izpēti jautājumus par jēgu, vērtībām un pieņēmumiem argumentētā sarunā.

#### Jēdzienu analīze

Skills: 4

[conceptualAnalysis.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophicalInquiry/conceptualAnalysis/conceptualAnalysis.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Careful discussion depends on tracking the boundaries of concepts, especially when ordinary words cover multiple cases. These abilities refine meanings rather than merely memorize technical vocabulary.

**User-friendly description (lv):** Izpēti, kā skaidras definīcijas un labi piemēri uzlabo filozofisko domāšanu.

##### Strīdīga jēdziena precizēšana

[clarifyAContestedConcept.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophicalInquiry/conceptualAnalysis/skills/clarifyAContestedConcept.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Specify relevant conditions or uses of a term such as freedom so interlocutors can determine what their disagreement concerns.

**User-friendly description (lv):** Precizē termina nozīmi, ja cilvēki nav vienisprātis par tā lietojumu.

##### Nepieciešamu un pietiekamu nosacījumu atšķiršana

[distinguishNecessaryFromSufficientConditions.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophicalInquiry/conceptualAnalysis/skills/distinguishNecessaryFromSufficientConditions.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Determine whether a proposed property is required for a concept to apply, enough for it to apply, or both; a condition can fail one test and pass the other.

**User-friendly description (lv):** Nosaki, vai nosacījums ir nepieciešams, pietiekams, abi vai neviens no tiem.

##### Definīcijas pārbaude ar pretpiemēru

[testADefinitionWithACounterexample.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophicalInquiry/conceptualAnalysis/skills/testADefinitionWithACounterexample.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Find a case included or excluded incorrectly by a proposed definition and explain what the case reveals about its limits.

**User-friendly description (lv):** Apšaubi definīciju, atrodot gadījumu, ko tā aplami klasificē.

##### Jēdziena izpēte domu eksperimentā

[useAThoughtExperimentToExamineAConcept.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophicalInquiry/conceptualAnalysis/skills/useAThoughtExperimentToExamineAConcept.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Vary features of an imagined situation to isolate a philosophical principle; make clear which assumptions are stipulated rather than observed.

**User-friendly description (lv):** Izmanto iztēlotu situāciju idejas pārbaudei, skaidri nosaucot pieņēmumus.

#### Dialogs un domstarpības

Skills: 4

[dialogueAndDisagreement.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophicalInquiry/dialogueAndDisagreement/dialogueAndDisagreement.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Reasoned dialogue seeks understanding and justified revision, not simply winning assent. Participants must fairly represent alternatives and keep interpersonal respect separate from agreement.

**User-friendly description (lv):** Uzzini, kā cieņpilnas domstarpības palīdz pārdomāt idejas no jauna.

##### Padziļināta filozofiska jautājuma uzdošana

[askAProbingPhilosophicalQuestion.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophicalInquiry/dialogueAndDisagreement/skills/askAProbingPhilosophicalQuestion.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Request a reason, distinction, implication, or counterexample that can advance inquiry without demanding personal disclosure.

**User-friendly description (lv):** Uzdod jautājumu, kas pārbauda otra cilvēka argumentus vai precizē viņa viedokli.

##### Cita cilvēka nostājas taisnīga atveide

[reconstructAnotherPersonsPositionFairly.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophicalInquiry/dialogueAndDisagreement/skills/reconstructAnotherPersonsPositionFairly.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Restate an interlocutor's strongest contextually plausible position accurately and charitably, rather than attacking a weaker caricature; fair reconstruction does not require overlooking genuine contradictions or unsupported claims.

**User-friendly description (lv):** Pirms kritizēt, precīzi atstāsti otra cilvēka nostāju.

##### Atbilde uz filozofisku iebildumu

[respondToAPhilosophicalObjection.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophicalInquiry/dialogueAndDisagreement/skills/respondToAPhilosophicalObjection.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Address the actual challenge to a claim, rather than diverting to the objector's identity or motives.

**User-friendly description (lv):** Atbildi uz iebilduma būtību, nevis uzbrūc tā autoram.

##### Nostājas pārskatīšana argumentu gaismā

[reviseAPositionInLightOfReasons.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophicalInquiry/dialogueAndDisagreement/skills/reviseAPositionInLightOfReasons.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify which premise or conclusion should change when a cogent objection defeats an earlier commitment.

**User-friendly description (lv):** Maini pārliecību vai argumentu, ja stiprāks pamatojums rāda, ka tas jāpārskata.

#### Jautājumi un problēmas

Skills: 4

[questionsAndProblems.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophicalInquiry/questionsAndProblems/questionsAndProblems.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** A productive philosophical problem can be examined through competing answers, explicit concepts, and reasons. The object is to make a question discussable without assuming that every question has a single empirical test.

**User-friendly description (lv):** Mācies mulsinošas idejas pārvērst jautājumos, kurus var rūpīgi apspriest.

##### Filozofiskas problēmas un piemēra atšķiršana

[distinguishAPhilosophicalProblemFromAnExample.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophicalInquiry/questionsAndProblems/skills/distinguishAPhilosophicalProblemFromAnExample.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Separate the general issue, such as whether promises create obligations, from the particular story used to make it vivid.

**User-friendly description (lv):** Atšķir vispārīgu filozofisku problēmu no stāsta, kas to ilustrē.

##### Filozofisku un empīrisku jautājumu atšķiršana

[distinguishPhilosophicalQuestionsFromEmpiricalQuestions.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophicalInquiry/questionsAndProblems/skills/distinguishPhilosophicalQuestionsFromEmpiricalQuestions.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify when an issue asks what a concept means, what ought to be done, or what ultimately explains something, rather than only requesting a measurable fact; many questions have both aspects.

**User-friendly description (lv):** Atpazīsti, kā filozofiski jautājumi atšķiras no tiem, uz kuriem atbild mērījumi.

##### Filozofiska jautājuma formulēšana

[formulateAPhilosophicalQuestion.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophicalInquiry/questionsAndProblems/skills/formulateAPhilosophicalQuestion.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Turn an ordinary puzzlement into an open question about meaning, reasons, values, or assumptions that admits more than a yes-or-no preference.

**User-friendly description (lv):** Uzdod atvērtu jautājumu par pamatojumu, jēgu vai vērtībām, nevis tikai gaumi.

##### Pieņēmumu noteikšana filozofiskā problēmā

[identifyAssumptionsInAPhilosophicalProblem.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophicalInquiry/questionsAndProblems/skills/identifyAssumptionsInAPhilosophicalProblem.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Expose propositions that a question or proposed answer takes for granted, such as what counts as a person or what makes an action fair.

**User-friendly description (lv):** Atrodi slēptos pieņēmumus filozofiska jautājuma vai piedāvātās atbildes pamatā.

### Valodas filozofija

Groups: 3 · Skills: 10

[philosophyOfLanguage.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfLanguage/philosophyOfLanguage.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Language is examined as a system for conveying meaning, referring to the world, performing actions, and shaping interpretation. Grammar instruction and literary composition remain primarily in Language and Literature.

**User-friendly description (lv):** Izpēti, kā vārdi nodod nozīmi, norāda uz lietām un veido izpratni.

#### Saziņa un interpretācija

Skills: 3

[communicationAndInterpretation.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfLanguage/communicationAndInterpretation/communicationAndInterpretation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** What a speaker says can differ from what a speaker conveys or does by saying it. Interpretation must take context and plausible alternatives into account.

**User-friendly description (lv):** Uzzini, kā konteksts ietekmē to, ko cilvēki saka un nodod citiem.

##### Burtiskās nozīmes un zemteksta atšķiršana

[distinguishLiteralMeaningFromImplication.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfLanguage/communicationAndInterpretation/skills/distinguishLiteralMeaningFromImplication.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify content explicitly expressed versus a reasonable conversational inference that could be cancelled or revised.

**User-friendly description (lv):** Atšķir izteikuma tiešo nozīmi no tā, ko tas liek noprast.

##### Kontekstuālu interpretāciju izvērtēšana

[evaluateContextualInterpretations.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfLanguage/communicationAndInterpretation/skills/evaluateContextualInterpretations.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Compare readings of an utterance using the speaker's context, conventions, and available evidence.

**User-friendly description (lv):** Izvēlies starp interpretācijām, ņemot vērā kontekstu un pieejamos pierādījumus.

##### Runas akta atpazīšana

[identifyASpeechAct.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfLanguage/communicationAndInterpretation/skills/identifyASpeechAct.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize how an utterance functions as a promise, request, warning, or assertion beyond its sentence structure.

**User-friendly description (lv):** Atpazīsti, kad izteikums pats veic darbību, piemēram, apsolīšanu vai lūgumu.

#### Valoda, patiesība un vara

Skills: 4

[languageTruthAndPower.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfLanguage/languageTruthAndPower/languageTruthAndPower.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Descriptive categories, framing, and public speech influence which interpretations appear available. Evaluating their justification differs from explaining psychological persuasion.

**User-friendly description (lv):** Izpēti, kā valoda pauž vērtējumus un veido publisko diskusiju.

##### Ietvarojuma izvēles analīze

[analyzeAFramingChoice.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfLanguage/languageTruthAndPower/skills/analyzeAFramingChoice.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how alternate labels foreground different aspects of one issue and test what evidence each framing leaves out.

**User-friendly description (lv):** Salīdzini apzīmējumus, kas izceļ dažādus vienas problēmas aspektus.

##### Izteikuma patiesuma nosacījumu analīze

[analyzeATruthConditionalClaim.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfLanguage/languageTruthAndPower/skills/analyzeATruthConditionalClaim.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify circumstances under which an assertion would count as true or false while recognizing context-dependent expressions.

**User-friendly description (lv):** Nosaki apstākļus, kuros apgalvojums būtu patiess vai aplams.

##### Aprakstošas un vērtējošas valodas atšķiršana

[distinguishDescriptiveFromEvaluativeLanguage.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfLanguage/languageTruthAndPower/skills/distinguishDescriptiveFromEvaluativeLanguage.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify how apparently factual wording can also express approval, disapproval, or a contested standard.

**User-friendly description (lv):** Atpazīsti, kad šķietami faktisks formulējums pauž arī vērtējumu.

##### Apgalvojuma par valodisko attēlojumu izvērtēšana

[evaluateAClaimAboutLinguisticRepresentation.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfLanguage/languageTruthAndPower/skills/evaluateAClaimAboutLinguisticRepresentation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Assess whether a label fairly describes people or phenomena without equating linguistic conventions with objective essences.

**User-friendly description (lv):** Apsver, vai cilvēku un lietu apraksti ir taisnīgi un pietiekami pamatoti.

#### Nozīme un atsauce

Skills: 3

[meaningAndReference.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfLanguage/meaningAndReference/meaningAndReference.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Words and sentences can express meanings beyond identifying objects; context, concepts, and the distinction between expression and referent affect analysis.

**User-friendly description (lv):** Uzzini atšķirību starp vārdu, tā nozīmi un to, uz ko tas norāda.

##### Vārda un tā referenta atšķiršana

[distinguishAWordFromItsReferent.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfLanguage/meaningAndReference/skills/distinguishAWordFromItsReferent.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain why a linguistic expression and the person, object, or kind it denotes are not identical.

**User-friendly description (lv):** Atšķir vārdu no lietas vai cilvēka, kuru tas nosauc.

##### Jēgas un atsauces atšķiršana

[distinguishSenseFromReference.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfLanguage/meaningAndReference/skills/distinguishSenseFromReference.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Analyze how different expressions can pick out the same entity while presenting it in different ways.

**User-friendly description (lv):** Atpazīsti, kā dažādi izteicieni atšķirīgos veidos norāda uz vienu objektu.

##### Semantiskās divdomības atpazīšana

[identifySemanticAmbiguity.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfLanguage/meaningAndReference/skills/identifySemanticAmbiguity.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize when a sentence admits multiple readings due to a word or syntactic structure rather than simply lacking evidence.

**User-friendly description (lv):** Atrodi teikumus ar vairāk nekā vienu iespējamo nozīmi.

### Reliģijas filozofija

Groups: 3 · Skills: 15

[philosophyOfReligion.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfReligion/philosophyOfReligion.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Reasoned inquiry into religious and nonreligious worldviews considers ultimate explanations, sources of belief, conceptions of divinity, and coexistence under pluralism. This domain evaluates arguments without prescribing worship, faith, atheism, or other personal commitments.

**User-friendly description (lv):** Izpēti argumentus par reliģiskiem un nereliģiskiem pasaules uzskatiem, neuzspiežot pārliecību.

#### Daudzveidība un jēga

Skills: 3

[diversityAndMeaning.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfReligion/diversityAndMeaning/diversityAndMeaning.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Competing outlooks on religion, nonbelief, and life purpose raise interpretive and normative problems. Dialogue must distinguish a disagreement about truth from respect for people's freedom of conscience.

**User-friendly description (lv):** Mācies cieņpilni apspriest atšķirības reliģijā, neticībā un dzīves jēgas izpratnē.

##### Analizēt reliģisko plurālismu kā filozofisku problēmu

[analyzeReligiousPluralismAsAPhilosophicalProblem.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfReligion/diversityAndMeaning/skills/analyzeReligiousPluralismAsAPhilosophicalProblem.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Compare accounts of how conflicting ultimate-belief claims might be understood and evaluated while respecting freedom of conscience.

**User-friendly description (lv):** Izpēti filozofiskas atbildes uz konkurējošiem reliģiskiem patiesības apgalvojumiem.

##### Analizēt reliģisko toleranci kā ētisku principu

[analyzeReligiousToleranceAsAnEthicalPrinciple.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfReligion/diversityAndMeaning/skills/analyzeReligiousToleranceAsAnEthicalPrinciple.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Examine justifications and limits for respecting divergent religious or nonreligious commitments, distinguishing toleration from endorsement.

**User-friendly description (lv):** Apsver iemeslus un robežas cieņai pret cilvēkiem ar atšķirīgu pārliecību.

##### Atšķirt reliģisko skepticismu no agnosticisma

[distinguishReligiousSkepticismFromAgnosticism.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfReligion/diversityAndMeaning/skills/distinguishReligiousSkepticismFromAgnosticism.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Separate withholding belief about particular religious claims from positions on the possibility of knowing whether divine reality exists.

**User-friendly description (lv):** Atšķir šaubas par reliģiskiem apgalvojumiem no nenoteiktības par to, ko var zināt.

#### Ticība, prāts un pieredze

Skills: 4

[faithReasonAndExperience.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfReligion/faithReasonAndExperience/faithReasonAndExperience.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Different accounts of religious knowledge appeal to reasoning, testimony, revelation, or experience. Philosophical examination weighs what these sources can justify and remains distinct from taking part in a religious practice.

**User-friendly description (lv):** Uzzini, kā ticību, spriešanu un pieredzi izmanto reliģisku apgalvojumu pamatošanai.

##### Salīdzināt ticību un prātu kā pamatojuma avotus

[compareFaithAndReasonAsSourcesOfJustification.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfReligion/faithReasonAndExperience/skills/compareFaithAndReasonAsSourcesOfJustification.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Analyze philosophical accounts in which faith and reasoning conflict, complement one another, or play different roles, without assuming one universal religious position.

**User-friendly description (lv):** Salīdzini uzskatus par to, kā ticība un spriešana viena otru atbalsta vai apšauba.

##### Atšķirt filozofisku izpēti no reliģiskas prakses

[distinguishPhilosophicalInquiryFromReligiousPractice.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfReligion/faithReasonAndExperience/skills/distinguishPhilosophicalInquiryFromReligiousPractice.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Separate reasoning about religious claims from performing rituals, accepting revelation, or participating in a tradition.

**User-friendly description (lv):** Atšķir reliģisku ideju apspriešanu no piedalīšanās reliģiskās praksēs.

##### Novērtēt apgalvojumu par ziņotu brīnumu

[evaluateAReportedMiracleClaim.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfReligion/faithReasonAndExperience/skills/evaluateAReportedMiracleClaim.data.ts)

**User-friendly description (lv):** Izvērtē apgalvojumu par neparastu notikumu, salīdzinot liecības un alternatīvus skaidrojumus.

##### Novērtēt reliģisko pieredzi kā pierādījumu

[evaluateReligiousExperienceAsEvidence.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfReligion/faithReasonAndExperience/skills/evaluateReligiousExperienceAsEvidence.data.ts)

**User-friendly description (lv):** Izpēti, vai personiska reliģiskā pieredze atbalsta plašāku apgalvojumu.

#### Galīgā realitāte un dievišķums

Skills: 8

[ultimateRealityAndDivinity.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfReligion/ultimateRealityAndDivinity/ultimateRealityAndDivinity.data.ts)

Their arguments may invoke experience, explanation, definition, or objections, without settling a worldview by stipulation.

##### Analizēt ontoloģisku argumentu

[analyzeAnOntologicalArgument.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfReligion/ultimateRealityAndDivinity/skills/analyzeAnOntologicalArgument.data.ts)

**User-friendly description (lv):** Izpēti argumentus, kas mēģina izsecināt dievišķo esamību no definīcijas.

##### Analizēt neteistiskus reliģiskus realitātes skaidrojumus

[analyzeNontheisticReligiousAccountsOfReality.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfReligion/ultimateRealityAndDivinity/skills/analyzeNontheisticReligiousAccountsOfReality.data.ts)

##### Novērtēt piedāvāto galīgo skaidrojumu

[evaluateAProposedUltimateExplanation.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfReligion/ultimateRealityAndDivinity/skills/evaluateAProposedUltimateExplanation.data.ts)

[reconstructAPhilosophicalArgumentAboutDivinity.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfReligion/ultimateRealityAndDivinity/skills/reconstructAPhilosophicalArgumentAboutDivinity.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify premises and conclusion in a theistic, atheistic, or agnostic argument without treating the position as settled by its name.

### Zinātnes filozofija

Groups: 4 · Skills: 26

[philosophyOfScience.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfScience/philosophyOfScience.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Scientific inquiry is examined as a way of building, testing, and revising explanations. The focus is on general methodology and evidential justification; physics, biology, psychology, and other sciences own their domain-specific investigations.

**User-friendly description (lv):** Izpēti, kā zinātniskus apgalvojumus pārbauda, pamato, pārskata un apšauba.

#### Pierādījumi un cēloņsakarību secināšana

Skills: 6

[evidenceAndCausalInference.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfScience/evidenceAndCausalInference/evidenceAndCausalInference.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Observations become informative only through assumptions about measurement, variation, and alternative explanations. The quality of a causal conclusion is not identical to the size of an observed association.

**User-friendly description (lv):** Izpēti, ko pierādījumi var un nevar parādīt par cēloņsakarībām.

##### Izvērtēt mērījuma validitāti

[assessMeasurementValidity.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfScience/evidenceAndCausalInference/skills/assessMeasurementValidity.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Determine whether an operational measure genuinely captures the construct a researcher claims to study.

**User-friendly description (lv):** Pārbaudi, vai mērījums tiešām mēra to, ko tas apgalvo mērām.

##### Izvērtēt izlases reprezentativitāti

[assessSampleRepresentativeness.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfScience/evidenceAndCausalInference/skills/assessSampleRepresentativeness.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Examine whether selection and coverage allow findings to extend to the population named in a conclusion.

**User-friendly description (lv):** Pārbaudi, vai atlasītie dalībnieki pārstāv plašāku populāciju.

##### Atšķirt korelāciju no cēloņsakarības

[distinguishCorrelationFromCausation.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfScience/evidenceAndCausalInference/skills/distinguishCorrelationFromCausation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain why two variables varying together does not alone show that changing one produces the other.

**User-friendly description (lv):** Saproti, ka divu mainīgo kopīgas izmaiņas nenozīmē, ka viens izraisa otru.

**Methodological description (English):** Judge how design, alternative explanations, limitations, and observed evidence jointly support or weaken a causal claim.

**User-friendly description (lv):** Vērtē cēloņsakarību apgalvojumus pēc pētījuma plāna, pierādījumiem un alternatīviem skaidrojumiem.

**User-friendly description (lv):** Izpēti, kā izlases atlase un mainīgums ietekmē novērtējuma precizitāti.

Skills: 9

[experimentalDesign.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfScience/experimentalDesign/experimentalDesign.data.ts)

[explainThePurposeOfAControlGroup.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfScience/experimentalDesign/skills/explainThePurposeOfAControlGroup.data.ts)

[identifyAnIndependentVariable.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfScience/experimentalDesign/skills/identifyAnIndependentVariable.data.ts)

[theoriesAndScientificPractice.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfScience/theoriesAndScientificPractice/theoriesAndScientificPractice.data.ts)

### Sociālā un politiskā filozofija

[socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy.data.ts)

**User-friendly description (lv):** Salīdzini uzskatus, kas tiesību autoritāti saista ar morāles principiem.

##### Tiesiskuma analīze

[analyzeTheRuleOfLaw.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/philosophyOfLaw/skills/analyzeTheRuleOfLaw.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Examine principles such as generality, accessibility, prospectivity, consistent application, and constraints on arbitrary power as grounds for evaluating a legal order.

**User-friendly description (lv):** Izpēti principus, kas padara likumus publiskus, paredzamus un ierobežo patvaļīgu varu.

##### Tiesību interpretācijas teoriju izvērtēšana

[evaluateTheoriesOfLegalInterpretation.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/philosophyOfLaw/skills/evaluateTheoriesOfLegalInterpretation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Assess how text, legislative purpose, precedent, and institutional role support competing interpretations of a legal provision without deciding a real legal dispute.

**User-friendly description (lv):** Apsver, kā teksts, mērķis un precedenti ietekmē tiesību normas interpretāciju.

#### Politiskā autoritāte

Skills: 4

[politicalAuthority.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/politicalAuthority/politicalAuthority.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Institutions exercise collective power that requires justification. Political legitimacy, coercion, and obedience are distinct concepts.

**User-friendly description (lv):** Pēti, kas padara politisko varu leģitīmu, nevis tikai spēcīgu.

##### Pilsoniskās nepakļaušanās analīze

[analyzeCivilDisobedience.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/politicalAuthority/skills/analyzeCivilDisobedience.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Consider the moral conditions, aims, and limits of nonviolent principled lawbreaking without equating legality with morality.

**User-friendly description (lv):** Apspried morālus argumentus par principiālu un nevardarbīgu likumu neievērošanu.

##### Sabiedriskā līguma argumentu salīdzināšana

[compareSocialContractArguments.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/politicalAuthority/skills/compareSocialContractArguments.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how alternative accounts use consent, cooperation, security, or fairness to justify political obligations.

**User-friendly description (lv):** Izvērtē pamatojumus publisko institūciju tiesībām noteikt normas.

##### Politiskās varas leģitimitātes izvērtēšana

[evaluateTheLegitimacyOfPoliticalAuthority.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/politicalAuthority/skills/evaluateTheLegitimacyOfPoliticalAuthority.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Examine reasons offered to justify the right to make binding public decisions, not merely whether an institution controls force.

**User-friendly description (lv):** Salīdzini argumentus, kas valdību pamato ar piekrišanu, drošību vai sadarbību.

##### Valsts piespiešanas robežu izvērtēšana

[evaluateTheLimitsOfStateCoercion.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/politicalAuthority/skills/evaluateTheLimitsOfStateCoercion.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Assess competing grounds for restricting individual actions, such as preventing harm or protecting rights.

**User-friendly description (lv):** Apsver, kad personiskās brīvības ierobežošana varētu būt pamatota.

#### Publiskais saprāts un pilsoniskā dzīve

Skills: 4

[publicReasonAndCivicLife.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/publicReasonAndCivicLife/publicReasonAndCivicLife.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** People with incompatible values must still make shared decisions. Philosophical inquiry examines how disagreements can be handled under pluralism and institutional accountability.

**User-friendly description (lv):** Uzzini, kā cilvēki ar dažādām vērtībām pamato lēmumus, kas skar visus.

##### Demokrātiskās leģitimitātes analīze

[analyzeDemocraticLegitimacy.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/publicReasonAndCivicLife/skills/analyzeDemocraticLegitimacy.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Evaluate the roles of participation, representation, minority protections, and accountability in justifying collective decisions.

**User-friendly description (lv):** Apsver, kā līdzdalība, pārstāvība un atbildība pamato demokrātiju.

##### Argumenta par kopējo labumu izvērtēšana

[assessAnArgumentAboutTheCommonGood.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/publicReasonAndCivicLife/skills/assessAnArgumentAboutTheCommonGood.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Examine who benefits, who bears costs, and whether a proposed collective interest disregards legitimate dissent.

**User-friendly description (lv):** Pārbaudi, kuru intereses pārstāv apgalvojums par kopējo labumu.

##### Publisku pamatojumu un privātu vēlmju atšķiršana

[distinguishPublicReasonsFromPrivatePreferences.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/publicReasonAndCivicLife/skills/distinguishPublicReasonsFromPrivatePreferences.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify justifications aimed at principles others can evaluate, rather than asserting that a personal desire must settle collective policy.

**User-friendly description (lv):** Atšķir publiskus iemeslus no privātām vēlmēm, kurām citiem nav jāpiekrīt.

##### Politiskā pienākuma uzskatu izvērtēšana

[evaluateCompetingViewsOfPoliticalObligation.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/publicReasonAndCivicLife/skills/evaluateCompetingViewsOfPoliticalObligation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Consider when citizens may have moral reasons to obey, criticize, or resist laws irrespective of mere fear of punishment.

**User-friendly description (lv):** Izpēti, kāpēc cilvēki ievēro likumus, tos apstrīd vai tiem pretojas.

#### Tiesības un brīvība

Skills: 4

[rightsAndLiberty.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/rightsAndLiberty/rightsAndLiberty.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** A right may protect a person's action, claim, or status and create obligations for others. Competing rights can require principled reconciliation.

**User-friendly description (lv):** Izpēti, uz kādām tiesībām cilvēki var pretendēt un ko nozīmē brīvība.

##### Tiesību konflikta analīze

[analyzeAConflictBetweenRights.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/rightsAndLiberty/skills/analyzeAConflictBetweenRights.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify whose claims compete and evaluate justified limits without assuming one right automatically cancels all others.

**User-friendly description (lv):** Apsver, kā atrisināt konfliktus starp svarīgām tiesībām.

##### Negatīvās un pozitīvās brīvības atšķiršana

[distinguishNegativeAndPositiveLiberty.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/rightsAndLiberty/skills/distinguishNegativeAndPositiveLiberty.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Contrast freedom from interference with capacities or opportunities to act, while recognizing debates about their relationship.

**User-friendly description (lv):** Salīdzini brīvību no iejaukšanās ar spēju efektīvi rīkoties.

##### Tiesību un privilēģiju atšķiršana

[distinguishRightsFromPrivileges.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/rightsAndLiberty/skills/distinguishRightsFromPrivileges.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify whether a claim concerns an entitlement owed to a person or an advantage conditional on discretionary permission.

**User-friendly description (lv):** Atšķir cilvēkam pienākošās tiesības no nosacīti piešķirtas privilēģijas.

##### Apziņas brīvības skaidrošana

[explainFreedomOfConscience.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/rightsAndLiberty/skills/explainFreedomOfConscience.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Assess why protecting personal belief and nonbelief may matter independently of agreement with any particular worldview.

**User-friendly description (lv):** Izpēti, kāpēc cilvēkiem jābūt brīviem reliģiskajā un nereliģiskajā pārliecībā.

#### Tehnoloģijas un sabiedrība

Skills: 3

[technologyAndSociety.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/technologyAndSociety/technologyAndSociety.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Technological artifacts and institutions shape the practical conditions of action, social change, and control. Philosophical analysis evaluates these mediation and agency claims rather than measuring product usage or engineering device performance.

**User-friendly description (lv):** Mācies analizēt, kā tehnoloģijas ietekmē cilvēku rīcību un sabiedrību.

##### Cilvēka autonomijas analīze tehnoloģiskajās sistēmās

[analyzeHumanAutonomyInTechnologicalSystems.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/technologyAndSociety/skills/analyzeHumanAutonomyInTechnologicalSystems.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Evaluate when reliance on automated or networked systems enhances or constrains meaningful choice and control, separate from the narrower ethics of individual algorithmic decisions.

**User-friendly description (lv):** Izpēti, kad tehnoloģijas palielina vai samazina cilvēka kontroli pār saviem lēmumiem.

##### Tehnoloģiskās starpniecības analīze

[analyzeTechnologicalMediation.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/technologyAndSociety/skills/analyzeTechnologicalMediation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Examine how a technological artifact changes the available actions, relationships, or choices through which people engage the world, without reducing the issue to the device's technical operation.

**User-friendly description (lv):** Pēti, kā tehnoloģijas maina cilvēkiem pieejamās izvēles un attiecības.

##### Tehnoloģiskā determinisma izvērtēšana

[evaluateTechnologicalDeterminism.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/technologyAndSociety/skills/evaluateTechnologicalDeterminism.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Assess arguments that technological development determines social arrangements, including objections based on political choice, design, and historical contingency.

**User-friendly description (lv):** Apšaubi, vai tehnoloģiju pārmaiņas vienas pašas nosaka sabiedrības attīstību.
